key_concepts: USD COMP imports USD, USDA, USDC, and USDZ scene assets into a generated TouchDesigner network.
Imported assets are cached as .tdc files in TDImportCache and read through Import Select TOP/SOP/CHOP operators.
Build Network is required after choosing a file or changing USD-page import options; Reload File refreshes assets without reshaping the network.
Update merges changes from an edited USD file into the existing generated network, with Keep Parameters and Keep Connections preserving manual edits.
Merge Geometry, Import POPs, Direct to GPU, material/camera generation, and actor generation choose the generated network shape and runtime performance path.
common_gotchas: USD page parameter changes require Build Network before the generated network reflects them.
Assets are cached to a .tdc file in TDImportCache next to the .toe; moving machines without that cache forces reimport.
Reload File refreshes assets without network changes, while Update merges changed USD content into the existing network.
Merge Geometry can significantly improve medium or large scene performance, but changes network shape.
Direct to GPU currently supports mesh and point primitives; unsupported prim types generate errors in Import Select SOPs.
Keep Parameter Values and Keep Connections matter when updating a generated network that has manual adjustments.
Play mode controls determine whether animation follows the timeline, a specified index, or sequential playback.
build_relevance: 2025.30000+ USD 25.05.01 import, cache, and playback workflow
